name: What does home accessibility remodeling typically include?

mainEntity.name: What does home accessibility remodeling typically include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Accessibility remodeling involves structural and cosmetic modifications that make a home safer and easier to use for individuals with mobility challenges, disabilities, or aging family members. Common projects include converting traditional bathtubs to zero-threshold walk-in showers, widening doorways for wheelchair clearance, lowering countertops, and installing solid blocking behind drywall for grab bars. At HH Remodeling, owner Abraham Becerra handles the custom framing, drywall adjustments, and tile work directly, ensuring additions like grab bars are anchored into solid structural studs rather than relying on hollow drywall anchors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Accessibility remodeling includes zero-threshold walk-in showers, widened doorways, lower counters, and structural wall blocking for secure grab bars to improve safety and mobility.
